entry.title: Fernbrook Energy doubles output
entry.summary: Short summary of the Fernbrook story.

div.p: Fernbrook Energy doubled solar output to 900 megawatts at its invented Calloway site.

The company said the expansion cost $520 million and was finished three months early. Chief executive Mara Lindqvist said a second phase would follow in 2027, subject to the made-up regional permit board.
Shares of the fictional company rose 6% on the news, and the invented utility Westmarch Power signed a ten-year purchase agreement for half of the new capacity.
Local officials in the made-up county said the project created 340 construction jobs and 45 permanent ones, and that a community fund would receive $2 million a year from the operator.
